name: fiber-optic-light-streams
description: Procedural fiber-optic light streaks with travelling colour waves, glowing bokeh tips, out-of-focus foreground cables and floor reflections (Three.js / WebGL 2 point-sprite bokeh renderer + HDR bloom pipeline).

scripts.render:v1: remotion render Fiber-Optic-Light-Streams-V1-Reference "out/Version 1 - Fiber Optic Light Streams (Reference Match).mp4" --scale=0.5
scripts.render:v2: remotion render Fiber-Optic-Light-Streams-V2-Aurora-Palette "out/Version 2 - Fiber Optic Light Streams (Aurora Palette).mp4" --scale=0.5
scripts.render:all: npm run render:v1 && npm run render:v2
